newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil airport speeds up work on cargo terminal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil airport speeds up work on cargo terminal.

text.p: Brazil's main international cargo airport of Viracopos in Campinas, Sao Paulo state, is speeding up work on its new cargo terminal, which should take up operation in May 1997, Brazilian airport operator Infraero said.
Infraero is investing 23 million reais ($23 million) in the new terminal, which will cover an area of 40,000 square meters.
A new control tower and parking ground for airplanes is also being built, allowing the airport to handle 19 large aircraft, Infraero said.
Viracopos handled 148,000 tonnes of cargo in 1995 and is set to handle more than 200,000 tonnes this year, Infraero said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
